status: Receive-only failure reproduced and correlated to native first-error capture; physical coupling path unresolved

fixture.RX_service: IRQ plus 300 us tail timer; FIFO drains, interrupt acknowledgment and error counters only

wiring.C4: Controller error marker on GPIO23 through the existing READY1 lead; Pi1 GPIO17 released as input

pulsed.error: Controller reports lost arbitration; SDA remains low, SCL high

interpretation.established: The failure does not require HSM execution, response publication, transmit enable, Pi1 READY transitions or per-request BSC reconfiguration.
interpretation.working_model: An extra high input sample early in 11110011 yields 11111001 (0xf9); a receiver ACK one nominal clock early explains wire 11110010 (0xf2) and the controller arbitration loss.
interpretation.signal_observation: READY2 falls during an SCL rising edge; SCL becomes non-monotonic and recrosses illustrative thresholds. Disturbances appear simultaneously on SDA and the otherwise released error-marker lead.
interpretation.limits: Probe skew, receiver thresholds, local grounds and the physical coupling path remain uncalibrated. Scope cross-talk/common-reference artifacts have not been separated from the disturbance at Pi1 input. This is not shared-bus qualification.
